description: Angular component for managing Two-Factor Authentication settings in the Thingsboard UI, including form building, data fetching, and saving logic.

classes.name: TwoFactorAuthSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring Two-Factor Authentication settings, including form controls, data retrieval, and user interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form and loads current 2FA settings.

methods.name: confirmForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for confirmation purposes.

methods.name: toggleExtensionPanel
methods.description: Opens or closes an expansion panel based on user interaction.

methods.name: trackByElement
methods.description: Tracks list items by their reference for performance optimization.

methods.name: build2faSettingsForm
methods.description: Constructs the reactive form for 2FA settings.

methods.name: setAuthConfigFormValue
methods.description: Populates the form with existing 2FA settings.

methods.name: buildProvidersSettingsForm
methods.description: Creates form controls for each 2FA provider type.

methods.name: getByIndexPanel
methods.description: Retrieves a specific expansion panel by index.

methods.name: splitRateLimit
methods.description: Splits rate limit string into numeric components.

methods.name: joinRateLimit
methods.description: Joins rate limit components into a string.

methods.name: allowNotificationTargetConfigTypes
methods.description: Returns allowed notification target configuration types.
